international.title: Ukraine critically damages Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia
international.summary: Zelenskyy praises ‘unprecedented attack’ but Kremlin claims bridge will be restored and will be ‘better than ever’ Europe live – follow latest Ukraine has critically damaged the Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia in an overnight missile attack, in what Volodymyr Zelenskyy hailed as an “unprecedented” military operation. Footage showed a Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missile seconds before it hit the road and railway crossing, followed by an explosion. The strike follows an earlier attack on Monday that targeted an arch across its central section. Continue reading...
